cohort: The study included 283 preterm neonates with gestational age less than or equal to 35 weeks, born between January 2015 and December 2019.
finding: Cumulative dose and duration of postnatal steroids are associated with increased systolic blood pressure and improved creatinine clearance (likely due to hyperfiltration) in premature infants.
followup_time: At the time of discharge from the neonatal intensive care unit
